about.headline: What do I get for $89?
about.body: Two weeks of unlimited classes at FIT X Studio: coached strength, mat Pilates, mums and bubs and Saturday HIIT. Your coach shows you the main lifts, helps you pick your starting weights and keeps an eye on your form. If you love it, stay on as a Premium member at $75 a week, and your two trial weeks count towards your minimum term.

items.label: Coached strength
items.title: Lift with a coach watching.
items.detail: Our main class. Structured weight training in a small group, programmed in five-week blocks so you practise the main lifts, add weight and track your progress. Max 14 per class.

items.label: Mat Pilates
items.title: Core, control and calm.
items.detail: Core, sculpt and control on the mat, no reformers. A good match for your lifting. Max 14 per class. Grip socks required (bring your own or buy from us).

items.label: Mums and bubs
items.title: Bub comes too.
items.detail: The same structure as our strength classes, with your little one in the play pen within view. Prams stay in the waiting area. Max 10 per class.

items.label: Saturday HIIT
items.title: Bring a partner.
items.detail: On Saturdays, bring a training partner of any gender and work in doubles, Hyrox-style.

items.label: Open gym
items.title: Your space, on your time.
items.detail: Staffed open gym sessions on the timetable, capped at 10 so it's never crowded. Included in Premium and Open Gym memberships.

items.label: Beginner workshops
items.title: Learn the lifts first.
items.detail: Learn the technique and fundamentals before your first class, so you walk in confident. Included in Premium.

items.label: Mini bar
items.title: Coffee's on us.
items.detail: Every membership includes the mini bar: coffee, protein shakes and pre-workouts.
